doc: Validates that a0 lies within the fixed address/id window [0x1010, 0x1010+0x7EFE8] (unsigned range check via (u32)(a0-0x1010) > 0x7EFE8). If out of range, returns 0. Otherwise calls func_8005D598(-1, a0) to obtain a value, latches the low 16 bits of that value into the global D_80079970[0] (halfword store), and returns that same 16-bit value left-shifted by the global shift amount D_80079980[0].

globals.name: D_80079970
globals.decl: extern s32 D_80079970[4]; /* only [0] used, as a u16 (halfword store via *(u16*)D_80079970 = v); array-of-4 s32 (>8B) convention forces %hi/%lo addressing, matching sibling functions' view of this global */

globals.name: D_80079980
globals.decl: extern s32 D_80079980[3]; /* shift-amount table; only [0] read here, matches established sibling convention (func_8005D598/func_8005D63C/func_8005D550/func_8005D1D0) */

calls: func_8005D598(s32 a0, s32 a1) -- called as func_8005D598(-1, a0); mode selector -1 in first arg, our parameter forwarded as second arg
